record.question: What remains unverified for Sonora Pass to Leavitt Lake Trail junction?
record.reason: The Sonora route still ends at the PCT junction. The Leavitt Lake branch now has a separately reviewed route and display chain; no automatic combined return itinerary is asserted. Jurisdiction along the Emigrant/Hoover divide, PCT permit applicability, Leavitt Peak, Dorothy Lake and Yosemite continuations, parking/highway crossing, atomic mileage and current conditions remain unresolved.
